  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const getContainerItems = (containerId: ContainerId) => items.filter((it) => it.container === containerId);
  const getItemCompletion = (itemId: string) => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return completions.find((c) => c.item_id === itemId && c.date === today);
  };

const handleItemTap = (item: ContainerItem) => {
    setActiveItem(item);
    setShowFirstPixel(false);
    setCurrentScreen('item-detail');
    fadeAnim.setValue(0);
    Animated.timing(fadeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 300, useNativeDriver: true }).start();
  };

const handleDeleteItem = (itemId: string) => {
    const item = items.find((i) => i.id === itemId);
    if (item && item.type !== 'grounding') {
      Alert.alert('Delete ritual?', `Remove "${item.title}" from your rituals?`, [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Delete',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: () => {
            setItems(items.filter((i) => i.id !== itemId));
            setCompletions(completions.filter((c) => c.item_id !== itemId));
          },
        },
      ]);
    }
  };

const handleOutcomeSelect = (outcome: Outcome) => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    triggerExhaleAnimation();

if (outcome === 'did') {
      setSelectedOutcome(outcome);
      if (shiftYesCount < 3) {
        setShowShiftModal(true);
      } else {
        flashPhrase('small current moved', () => {
          setTempAfterfeel(null);
          setTempTags([]);
          setCurrentScreen('outcome');
        });
      }
    } else {
      const completion: Completion = {
        item_id: activeItem.id,
        container: activeItem.container,
        date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        outcome,
      };
      setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
      flashPhrase(undefined, () => {
        setActiveItem(null);
        setCurrentScreen('containers');
      });
    }
  };

const handleAfterfeelSelect = (afterfeel: Afterfeel, tags: ResonanceTag[]) => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    const outcomeToSave: Outcome = selectedOutcome ?? 'did';

const completion: Completion = {
      item_id: activeItem.id,
      container: activeItem.container,
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      outcome: outcomeToSave,
      afterfeel,
      resonance_tags: tags,
    };

setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
    flashPhrase(undefined, () => {
      setActiveItem(null);
      setSelectedOutcome(null);
      setCurrentScreen('containers');
    });
  };

const handleShiftResponse = (felt: boolean) => {
    if (felt) setShiftYesCount(shiftYesCount + 1);
    setShowShiftModal(false);
    setTempAfterfeel(null);
    setTempTags([]);
    setCurrentScreen('outcome');
  };

const handleShiftSkipAlways = () => {
    setShiftYesCount(999);
    setShowShiftModal(false);
    setTempAfterfeel(null);
    setTempTags([]);
    setCurrentScreen('outcome');
  };

const handleAddItem = () => {
    if (!newItemTitle.trim()) return;
    const newItem: ContainerItem = {
      id: `item-${Date.now()}`,
      type: newItemType,
      title: newItemTitle.trim(),
      container: currentContainer,
      time: newItemType === 'appointment' ? newItemTime : undefined,
      date: newItemType === 'appointment' ? new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] : undefined,
    };
    setItems([...items, newItem]);
    setNewItemTitle('');
    setNewItemTime('');
    setAddModalVisible(false);
  };

// Substances
  const addSubstanceLog = () => {
    if (!String(newSub.name || '').trim()) return;
    const now = new Date();
    const entry: SubstanceLog = {
      id: `sub-${now.getTime()}`,
      date_iso: now.toISOString(),
      day_key: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      name: String(newSub.name).trim(),
      amount: newSub.amount ? Number(newSub.amount) : undefined,
      unit: newSub.unit || undefined,
      route: newSub.route,
      intention: newSub.intention,
      notes: newSub.notes || undefined,
      craving_before: Number(newSub.craving_before) || 0,
      craving_after: Number(newSub.craving_after) || 0,
      effects: newSub.effects,
    };
    setSubstanceLogs([entry, ...substanceLogs]);
    setNewSub({
      name: '',
      amount: '' as unknown as number | string,
      unit: '',
      route: 'oral',
      intention: 'relief',
      notes: '',
      craving_before: 0,
      craving_after: 0,
      effects: 'same',
    });
    setCurrentScreen('substances');
  };

## Option A — install the dependency (recommended)

In your project **root**:

**If you’re using Expo (Expo Go / expo-router):**
```bash
npx expo install @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
# then clear cache + restart

```

**If you’re bare React Native:**
```bash

# or: yarn add @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
# iOS only:
npx pod-install
# then rebuild the app
```

That’s it. Keep the import I gave you:
```ts
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
```

## Option B — run without persistence (quick workaround)

If you can’t install right now, you can temporarily run with no-op storage so the app works without saving logs between launches.

1) **Delete** this line near the top:
```ts
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
```

2) **Add** this helper right under your other imports:
```ts
// TEMP storage shim (no persistence). Install @react-native-async-storage/async-storage to replace this.
const Storage = {
  getItem: async (_key: string) => null as string | null,
  setItem: async (_key: string, _value: string) => {},
};
```

3) **Replace** the two places that reference AsyncStorage:

- Load logs:
```ts
// BEFORE
const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem('substanceLogs');

// AFTER
const saved = await Storage.getItem('substanceLogs');
```

- Save logs:
```ts
// BEFORE
AsyncStorage.setItem('substanceLogs', JSON.stringify(substanceLogs));

// AFTER
Storage.setItem('substanceLogs', JSON.stringify(substanceLogs));
```

(Those are the only two calls.)

---

### Why you saw that red screen
Metro (the bundler) can’t resolve `@react-native-async-storage/async-storage`, so it throws an **UnableToResolveError** and returns **500**. Installing the package (Option A) resolves it instantly. The long stack trace is just Metro complaining it looked in a bunch of `node_modules` folders and didn’t find the module.

If you hit anything else after installing (e.g., cache weirdness), do this quick cleanup:

```bash
# from project root
rm -rf .expo
npx expo start -c
```

[1761107959.888419] Assistant: Gotcha—since you’re on **Expo Go** and want a way to “publish locally,” here are two good paths. Pick the one that matches what you want:

---

# 1) Stay in Expo Go, run locally/offline
This is still a dev workflow (no APK), but **no cloud** and it works on your LAN.

**Steps**
1. Install deps (AsyncStorage works in Expo Go):
   ```bash
   npx expo install @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
   ```
2. Start the bundler **offline** (or LAN):
   ```bash
   npx expo start --offline
   # or
   npx expo start --lan
   ```
3. Open **Expo Go** on your phone → scan the QR.  
   (Phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi, or use `--tunnel` if not.)

> This doesn’t produce an installable app, but your project never leaves your network.

---

---

# 2) Build an **installable APK locally** (no Expo cloud)
This creates a file you can sideload onto your Android device.

### Prereqs (Windows/Android)
- Node 18+ and Git
- **Android Studio** with SDK + platform tools (so `adb` works)
- **Java 17** (Adoptium Temurin 17 is solid)
- Global EAS CLI:
  ```bash
  npm i -g eas-cli
  ```

### One-time project setup
1. Initialize EAS in your project root:
   ```bash
   eas init
   ```
2. Add a minimal `eas.json` in your project root (create it if missing):
   ```json
   {
     "cli": { "version": ">= 10.0.0" },
     "build": {
       "preview": {
         "android": { "gradleCommand": ":app:assembleRelease" }
       }
     }
   }
   ```
   - **preview** → makes a **release APK** you can install directly (no Play Store).
   - If you need an **.aab** for Play Store, switch to `:app:bundleRelease`.

### Build the APK **locally**
```bash
eas build --platform android --profile preview --local
```
- Output ends up under something like `dist/*.apk`.

### Install to your device
1. Enable **USB debugging** on your Android.
2. Connect via USB, then:
   ```bash
   adb install -r dist/your-app-release.apk
   ```
   (If `adb` isn’t on PATH, open *Android Studio → SDK Manager → SDK Tools* and install *Platform Tools*.)

> This is fully local: no “expo publish,” no cloud build. You can repeat the build and reinstall anytime.

---

## Which should you use?
- **Just testing on your device?** Use **Option 1** (Expo Go + `--offline`).
- **Want a tappable icon, no cloud, works without dev server?** Use **Option 2** (local APK via EAS Local Build).

---

## Notes for iOS (in case you need it later)
- Requires a **Mac + Xcode**.
- Local build:
  ```bash
  eas build --platform ios --profile preview --local
  ```
- You’ll get an **.ipa**. Installing to a physical device requires signing and either **Apple Configurator** or TestFlight.

---

In your project root:
```bash

npx expo start -c
```
That resolves the “Unable to resolve module @react-native-async-storage/async-storage” red screen.

# 1) Add a Settings store (for *your* preferences)

Create a simple preferences context that persists to AsyncStorage. You’ll toggle things like font size, high-contrast theme, reduced motion, larger touch targets, haptics, etc.

```tsx
// PreferencesContext.tsx
import React, {createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useMemo} from 'react';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { AccessibilityInfo } from 'react-native';

type Prefs = {
  textScale: number;              // 0.9 - 1.6
  highContrast: boolean;
  reducedMotion: boolean;
  largeTargets: boolean;          // bigger buttons / hitSlop
  haptics: boolean;
  dyslexiaFont: boolean;
};

const DEFAULT: Prefs = {
  textScale: 1.0,
  highContrast: false,
  reducedMotion: false,
  largeTargets: true,
  haptics: true,
  dyslexiaFont: false,
};

const Ctx = createContext<{
  prefs: Prefs;
  setPrefs: (u: Partial<Prefs>) => void;
  ready: boolean;
}>({prefs: DEFAULT, setPrefs: () => {}, ready: false});

export const PreferencesProvider: React.FC<{children: React.ReactNode}> = ({children}) => {
  const [prefs, setPrefsState] = useState<Prefs>(DEFAULT);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

const setPrefs = (u: Partial<Prefs>) => {
    setPrefsState(prev => {
      const next = {...prev, ...u};
      AsyncStorage.setItem('@prefs', JSON.stringify(next)).catch(()=>{});
      return next;
    });
  };

useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      // load saved prefs
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@prefs');
      let base = raw ? {...DEFAULT, ...JSON.parse(raw)} : DEFAULT;

// auto-detect OS accessibility:
      try {
        const rm = await AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled();
        base.reducedMotion = base.reducedMotion || rm;
      } catch {}
      setPrefsState(base);
      setReady(true);
    })();
  }, []);

const value = useMemo(() => ({prefs, setPrefs, ready}), [prefs, ready]);
  return <Ctx.Provider value={value}>{children}</Ctx.Provider>;
};

export const usePrefs = () => useContext(Ctx);
```

**Wire it up:** wrap your app export:

```tsx
// App.tsx (or your root)
import { PreferencesProvider } from './PreferencesContext';
export default function App() {
  return (
    <PreferencesProvider>
      <PDATaskAppV2 />
    </PreferencesProvider>
  );
}
```

---

# 2) Respect preferences in your screens

- Scale text with `prefs.textScale`.
- Switch to a **high-contrast** palette if `prefs.highContrast`.
- Reduce/skip animations if `prefs.reducedMotion`.
- Add bigger tap areas if `prefs.largeTargets`.
- Optional haptics (Expo Go supports `expo-haptics`).

### a) High-contrast theme (drop-in)
Add this extra theme to your `THEMES` and choose based on prefs:

```tsx
const THEMES: { [k: string]: ThemeColors } = {
  // …your existing themes
  highContrast: {
    bg: '#000000',
    card: '#111111',
    accent: '#00FF88',
    text: '#FFFFFF',
    dim: '#B5B5B5',
  },
};
```

Use it like:
```tsx
import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';
import { usePrefs } from './PreferencesContext';

// inside PDATaskAppV2()
const { prefs } = usePrefs();
const activeThemeName = prefs.highContrast ? 'highContrast' : theme; // fallback to your current choice
const colors = THEMES[activeThemeName];
```

### b) Scale text with a helper
```tsx
const S = (n: number, scale: number) => Math.round(n * scale);
// usage: style={{ fontSize: S(18, prefs.textScale) }}
```

Update a few key text styles where readability matters (titles, buttons).

### c) Respect reduced motion
Wrap your animations with a guard:

```tsx
const triggerExhaleAnimation = () => {
  if (prefs.reducedMotion) return; // skip
  // your existing animation…
};
```

### d) Bigger touch targets + accessibility props
Add `hitSlop` and `accessibilityRole/Label/Hint` to important buttons:

---

```tsx
<TouchableOpacity
  onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('did')}
  style={[styles.outcomeButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent, minHeight: prefs.largeTargets ? 56 : 48 }]}
  hitSlop={prefs.largeTargets ? {top:10,bottom:10,left:10,right:10} : undefined}
  accessibilityRole="button"
  accessibilityLabel="Mark task as done"
  accessibilityHint="Saves this as completed and opens the feelings screen"
>
  <Text style={[styles.outcomeButtonText, { fontSize: S(18, prefs.textScale), color: colors.text }]}>
    did it
  </Text>
</TouchableOpacity>
```

(Do the same for “skipped/forgot/couldn’t/not relevant”, “done”, “skip”, nav tabs, etc.)

---

# 3) Add a simple **Settings** screen

Make a tiny screen to tweak preferences (text size slider, high contrast toggle, etc.). You can render it as a modal from your header.

```tsx
// SettingsSheet.tsx
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, Switch, Slider as RNSlider, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { usePrefs } from './PreferencesContext';

export default function SettingsSheet({colors}:{colors: ThemeColors}) {
  const { prefs, setPrefs } = usePrefs();

return (
    <View style={{padding:16}}>
      <Text style={{fontSize:18, color: colors.text, marginBottom:8}}>Accessibility & Personalization</Text>

<Text style={{color: colors.text, marginTop:12}}>Text size</Text>
      {/* expo sdk 51+: use @react-native-community/slider; in Expo Go you can still import Slider from 'react-native' on some versions */}
      <RNSlider
        minimumValue={0.9}
        maximumValue={1.6}
        step={0.05}
        value={prefs.textScale}
        onValueChange={v => setPrefs({textScale: v})}
      />

<Row label="High contrast" value={prefs.highContrast} onChange={v=>setPrefs({highContrast: v})}/>
      <Row label="Reduce motion" value={prefs.reducedMotion} onChange={v=>setPrefs({reducedMotion: v})}/>
      <Row label="Large touch targets" value={prefs.largeTargets} onChange={v=>setPrefs({largeTargets: v})}/>
      <Row label="Haptics" value={prefs.haptics} onChange={v=>setPrefs({haptics: v})}/>
      <Row label="Dyslexia-friendly font (OpenDyslexic)" value={prefs.dyslexiaFont} onChange={v=>setPrefs({dyslexiaFont: v})}/>
    </View>
  );
}

function Row({label,value,onChange}:{label:string;value:boolean;onChange:(v:boolean)=>void}) {
  return (
    <View style={{flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'space-between', marginTop:12}}>
      <Text style={{fontSize:16}}>{label}</Text>
      <Switch value={value} onValueChange={onChange}/>
    </View>
  );
}
```

Add a small gear button in your header that toggles a modal with `<SettingsSheet/>`.

# 4) Optional: Dyslexia-friendly font

- Drop **OpenDyslexic** or **Atkinson Hyperlegible** TTF into `assets/fonts`.
- Load with `expo-font` and conditionally use it if `prefs.dyslexiaFont`.

```tsx
// at app root
import * as Font from 'expo-font';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const [fontsReady, setFontsReady] = useState(false);
useEffect(() => {
  (async () => {
    await Font.loadAsync({
      OpenDyslexic: require('./assets/fonts/OpenDyslexic-Regular.otf'),
    });
    setFontsReady(true);
  })();
}, []);

const fontFamily = prefs.dyslexiaFont ? 'OpenDyslexic' : undefined;
// apply in text styles: { fontFamily }
```

---

# 5) Screen reader: make every interactive thing *speakable*

- Every `TouchableOpacity` should have `accessibilityRole` + `accessibilityLabel` + short `accessibilityHint`.
- Avoid “icon-only” without a label.
- Ensure overlays like your phrase toast have `pointerEvents="none"` (you already did) so they don’t trap focus.

Example for the **done** button:

```tsx
<TouchableOpacity
  onPress={onDone}
  accessibilityRole="button"
  accessibilityLabel="Done"
  accessibilityHint="Saves how it felt and returns to your list"
/>
```

---

# 6) Reduce cognitive load (personalization ideas you can enable)

- **Pin favorites:** long-press an item to “pin”; show pinned at top. (Store a `pinnedIds` array in AsyncStorage.)
- **Soft mode:** a setting to hide “skipped/forgot/couldn’t” so only “did it” is shown when you want less pressure.
- **Adaptive first-pixel:** use your existing completion history to surface the item with the highest “did” rate at this time of day.
- **Custom phrases:** let you edit the completion phrases list in Settings.
- **Privacy mode:** a toggle to blur item text on the main list (unblurs when tapped) if you’re in public.

These are just extra booleans/arrays in the same `prefs` context.

---

# 7) Gentle haptics on key actions (optional)

```tsx
import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';

const onCompleted = async () => {
  if (prefs.haptics) {
    await Haptics.selectionAsync();  // or impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium)
  }
  // …save completion
};
```

---

# 8) Substance tab: small accessibility touch-ups

- For each log row, announce the substance name and dose.
- “Quick log” buttons should have large hitSlop and labels (“Log 1 drink”, etc.).
- Add a **daily goal** ring with an accessible description (`accessibilityLabel="Daily alcohol goal progress"` + `accessibilityValue` with the %).

    setActiveItem(item);
    setShowFirstPixel(false);
    setCurrentScreen('item-detail');
    fadeAnim.setValue(0);
    Animated.timing(fadeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 300, useNativeDriver: true }).start();
  };

const handleDeleteItem = (itemId: string) => {
    const item = items.find((i) => i.id === itemId);
    if (item && item.type !== 'grounding') {
      Alert.alert('Delete ritual?', `Remove "${item.title}" from your rituals?`, [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Delete',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: () => {
            setItems(items.filter((i) => i.id !== itemId));
            setCompletions(completions.filter((c) => c.item_id !== itemId));
          },
        },
      ]);
    }
  };

const handleOutcomeSelect = (outcome: Outcome) => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    triggerExhaleAnimation();

if (outcome === 'did') {
      setSelectedOutcome(outcome);
      if (shiftYesCount < 3) {
        setShowShiftModal(true);
      } else {
        flashPhrase('small current moved', () => {
          setTempAfterfeel(null);
          setTempTags([]);
          setCurrentScreen('outcome');
        });
      }
    } else {
      const completion: Completion = {
        item_id: activeItem.id,
        container: activeItem.container,
        date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        outcome,
      };
      setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
      flashPhrase(undefined, () => {
        setActiveItem(null);
        setCurrentScreen('containers');
      });
    }
  };

const handleAfterfeelSelect = (afterfeel: Afterfeel, tags: ResonanceTag[]) => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    const outcomeToSave: Outcome = selectedOutcome ?? 'did';

const completion: Completion = {
      item_id: activeItem.id,
      container: activeItem.container,
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      outcome: outcomeToSave,
      afterfeel,
      resonance_tags: tags,
    };

setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
    flashPhrase(undefined, () => {
      setActiveItem(null);
      setSelectedOutcome(null);
      setCurrentScreen('containers');
    });
  };

const handleShiftResponse = (felt: boolean) => {
    if (felt) setShiftYesCount(shiftYesCount + 1);
    setShowShiftModal(false);
    setTempAfterfeel(null);
    setTempTags([]);
    setCurrentScreen('outcome');
  };

const handleShiftSkipAlways = () => {
    setShiftYesCount(999);
    setShowShiftModal(false);
    setTempAfterfeel(null);
    setTempTags([]);
    setCurrentScreen('outcome');
  };

const handleAddItem = () => {
    if (!newItemTitle.trim()) return;
    const newItem: ContainerItem = {
      id: `item-${Date.now()}`,
      type: newItemType,
      title: newItemTitle.trim(),
      container: currentContainer,
      time: newItemType === 'appointment' ? newItemTime : undefined,
      date: newItemType === 'appointment' ? new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] : undefined,
    };
    setItems([...items, newItem]);
    setNewItemTitle('');
    setNewItemTime('');
    setAddModalVisible(false);
  };

// Substances
  const addSubstanceLog = () => {
    if (!String(newSub.name || '').trim()) return;
    const now = new Date();
    const entry: SubstanceLog = {
      id: `sub-${now.getTime()}`,
      date_iso: now.toISOString(),
      day_key: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      name: String(newSub.name).trim(),
      amount: newSub.amount ? Number(newSub.amount) : undefined,
      unit: newSub.unit || undefined,
      route: newSub.route,
      intention: newSub.intention,
      notes: newSub.notes || undefined,
      craving_before: Number(newSub.craving_before) || 0,
      craving_after: Number(newSub.craving_after) || 0,
      effects: newSub.effects,
    };
    setSubstanceLogs([entry, ...substanceLogs]);
    setNewSub({
      name: '',
      amount: '' as unknown as number | string,
      unit: '',
      route: 'oral',
      intention: 'relief',
      notes: '',
      craving_before: 0,
      craving_after: 0,
      effects: 'same',
    });
    setCurrentScreen('substances');
  };

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: CONTAINERS (MAIN)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (currentScreen === 'containers') {
    const containerData = containers.find((c) => c.id === currentContainer);
    const containerItems = getContainerItems(currentContainer);
    const incomplete = containerItems.filter((i) => !getItemCompletion(i.id));
    const firstPixelItem = incomplete.length > 0 ? incomplete[0] : null;

return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          {/* Header */}
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <Text style={[styles.containerTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{containerData?.label}</Text>

---

<View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 16 }}>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('patterns')}>
                <Text style={[styles.headerLink, { color: colors.accent }]}>patterns</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('substances')}>
                <Text style={[styles.headerLink, { color: colors.accent }]}>substances</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>

<Text style={[styles.containerSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>
            {new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}
          </Text>

{/* First Pixel */}
          {showFirstPixel && firstPixelItem && (
            <View style={styles.firstPixelContainer}>
              <Text style={[styles.firstPixelPrompt, { color: colors.dim }]}>Want to try one tiny thing?</Text>

<TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => handleItemTap(firstPixelItem)}
                style={[styles.firstPixelCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.itemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{firstPixelItem.title}</Text>
                {firstPixelItem.body_cue && (
                  <Text style={[styles.itemCue, { color: colors.dim }]}>{firstPixelItem.body_cue}</Text>
                )}
                <View style={styles.itemActions}>
                  <Text style={[styles.actionText, { color: colors.accent }]}>try it</Text>
                </View>
              </TouchableOpacity>

<TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowFirstPixel(false)}>
                <Text style={[styles.showAllText, { color: colors.dim }]}>show all →</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          )}

{/* All Items */}
          {!showFirstPixel && (
            <>
              {/* Return points */}
              <View style={styles.section}>
                <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>RETURN POINTS</Text>
                {containerItems
                  .filter((i) => i.type === 'grounding')
                  .map((item) => {
                    const completion = getItemCompletion(item.id);
                    return (
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        key={item.id}
                        onPress={() => handleItemTap(item)}
                        style={[
                          styles.itemCard,
                          { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: completion ? colors.accent : colors.dim },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <Text style={[styles.itemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>
                          {completion ? '✓ ' : '○ '}
                          {item.title}
                        </Text>
                        {completion && (
                          <Text style={[styles.completionNote, { color: colors.dim }]}>
                            {completion.outcome === 'did' ? 'done' : completion.outcome}
                          </Text>
                        )}
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    );
                  })}
              </View>

{/* Your rituals */}
              {containerItems.some((i) => i.type === 'custom') && (
                <View style={styles.section}>
                  <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>YOUR RITUALS</Text>
                  {containerItems
                    .filter((i) => i.type === 'custom')
                    .map((item) => {
                      const completion = getItemCompletion(item.id);
                      return (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={item.id}
                          onPress={() => handleItemTap(item)}
                          onLongPress={() => handleDeleteItem(item.id)}
                          style={[
                            styles.itemCard,
                            { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: completion ? colors.accent : colors.dim },
                          ]}
                        >
                          <Text style={[styles.itemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>
                            {completion ? '✓ ' : '○ '}
                            {item.title}
                          </Text>
                          <Text style={[styles.longPressHint, { color: colors.dim }]}>(long press to delete)</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      );
                    })}
                </View>
              )}

{/* Time markers */}
              {containerItems.some((i) => i.type === 'appointment') && (
                <View style={styles.section}>
                  <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>TIME MARKERS</Text>
                  {containerItems
                    .filter((i) => i.type === 'appointment')
                    .map((item) => {
                      const completion = getItemCompletion(item.id);
                      return (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={item.id}
                          onPress={() => handleItemTap(item)}
                          onLongPress={() => handleDeleteItem(item.id)}
                          style={[
                            styles.itemCard,
                            { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: completion ? colors.accent : colors.dim },
                          ]}
                        >
                          <Text style={[styles.itemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>
                            {item.time && `${item.time} • `}
                            {item.title}
                          </Text>
                          {completion && (
                            <Text style={[styles.completionNote, { color: colors.dim }]}>
                              {completion.outcome === 'did' ? 'went' : completion.outcome}
                            </Text>
                          )}
                          <Text style={[styles.longPressHint, { color: colors.dim }]}>(long press to delete)</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      );
                    })}
                </View>
              )}

{/* Craft moment */}
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => setAddModalVisible(true)}
                style={[styles.addButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.addButtonText, { color: colors.accent }]}>+ craft your moment</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </>
          )}

{/* Container nav */}
          <View style={styles.containerNav}>
            {containers.map((c) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={c.id}
                onPress={() => {
                  setCurrentContainer(c.id);
                  setShowFirstPixel(true);
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.containerNavButton,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.id === currentContainer ? colors.accent : colors.card,
                    borderColor: colors.accent,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.containerNavText,
                    { color: c.id === currentContainer ? colors.text : colors.dim },
                  ]}
                >
                  {c.label.split(' ')[0]}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>

{/* Theme switch */}
          <View style={styles.themeSwitcher}>
            {Object.keys(THEMES).map((t) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={t}
                onPress={() => setTheme(t as 'forest' | 'studio' | 'cosmic')}
                style={[
                  styles.themeCircle,
                  { backgroundColor: THEMES[t].accent, borderWidth: theme === t ? 3 : 0, borderColor: colors.text },
                ]}
              />
            ))}
          </View>
        </ScrollView>

{/* Add Item Modal */}
        <Modal visible={addModalVisible} transparent animationType="slide">
          <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
            <View style={[styles.modalContent, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.modalTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>Add to {containerData?.label}</Text>

<View style={styles.typeSelector}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setNewItemType('custom')}
                  style={[
                    styles.typeButton,
                    { backgroundColor: newItemType === 'custom' ? colors.accent : colors.bg, borderColor: colors.accent },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.typeButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Ritual</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setNewItemType('appointment')}
                  style={[
                    styles.typeButton,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: newItemType === 'appointment' ? colors.accent : colors.bg,
                      borderColor: colors.accent,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.typeButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Time Marker</Text>

---

</TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

<TextInput
                style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: colors.bg, color: colors.text, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
                placeholder="What?"
                placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                value={newItemTitle}
                onChangeText={setNewItemTitle}
              />

{newItemType === 'appointment' && (
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: colors.bg, color: colors.text, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
                  placeholder="Time (e.g., 2:30pm)"
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={newItemTime}
                  onChangeText={setNewItemTime}
                />
              )}

<View style={styles.modalActions}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => {
                    setAddModalVisible(false);
                    setNewItemTitle('');
                    setNewItemTime('');
                  }}
                  style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.dim }]}>Cancel</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleAddItem} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Add</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </Modal>

{/* Micro-affirmation overlay (non-blocking) */}
        {completionPhrase ? (
          <Animated.View pointerEvents="none" style={[styles.phraseOverlay, { opacity: phraseOpacity }]}>
            <View style={[styles.phraseBox, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.phraseText, { color: colors.accent }]}>{completionPhrase}</Text>
            </View>
          </Animated.View>
        ) : null}

{/* Shift modal */}
        <Modal visible={showShiftModal} transparent animationType="fade">
          <View style={styles.shiftModalOverlay}>
            <View style={[styles.shiftModalContent, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.shiftModalText, { color: colors.text }]}>feel that shift?</Text>
              <View style={styles.shiftModalButtons}>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => handleShiftResponse(true)} style={[styles.shiftModalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.shiftModalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>yes</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => handleShiftResponse(false)}
                  style={[styles.shiftModalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent, borderWidth: 1 }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.shiftModalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>not yet</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleShiftSkipAlways}>
                <Text style={[styles.shiftModalSkip, { color: colors.dim }]}>skip always</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </Modal>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: ITEM DETAIL
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (currentScreen === 'item-detail' && activeItem) {
    const completion = getItemCompletion(activeItem.id);
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <Animated.ScrollView style={{ opacity: fadeAnim }} contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { setCurrentScreen('containers'); setActiveItem(null); }} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }] }}>
            <Text style={[styles.detailTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{activeItem.title}</Text>
          </Animated.View>

{activeItem.body_cue && (
            <View style={[styles.cueBox, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderLeftColor: colors.accent }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.cueLabel, { color: colors.dim }]}>body cue:</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.cueText, { color: colors.text }]}>{activeItem.body_cue}</Text>
            </View>
          )}

{activeItem.micro_version && (
            <View style={[styles.microBox, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.microLabel, { color: colors.dim }]}>or try micro version:</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.microText, { color: colors.accent }]}>{activeItem.micro_version}</Text>
            </View>
          )}

{!completion ? (
            <View style={styles.outcomeButtons}>
              <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('did')} style={[styles.outcomeButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]} accessibilityLabel="Mark as did it">
                <Text style={[styles.outcomeButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>did it</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>

<View style={styles.outcomeRow}>
                <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('skipped')} style={[styles.outcomeButtonSmall, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.outcomeButtonTextSmall, { color: colors.text }]}>skipped</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('forgot')} style={[styles.outcomeButtonSmall, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.outcomeButtonTextSmall, { color: colors.text }]}>forgot</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

<View style={styles.outcomeRow}>
                <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('couldnt')} style={[styles.outcomeButtonSmall, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.outcomeButtonTextSmall, { color: colors.text }]}>couldn't</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('not_relevant')} style={[styles.outcomeButtonSmall, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.dim }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.outcomeButtonTextSmall, { color: colors.dim }]}>not relevant</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.completedBox, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.completedText, { color: colors.accent }]}>marked as: {completion.outcome}</Text>
              {completion.afterfeel && <Text style={[styles.completedDetail, { color: colors.dim }]}>felt: {completion.afterfeel}</Text>}
              {completion.resonance_tags?.length ? (
                <Text style={[styles.completedDetail, { color: colors.dim }]}>tags: {completion.resonance_tags.join(', ')}</Text>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          )}
        </Animated.ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: OUTCOME (AFTERFEEL + TAGS)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (currentScreen === 'outcome') {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <Text style={[styles.outcomeTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>How did it feel?</Text>

<View style={styles.afterfeelButtons}>
            {(['lighter', 'same', 'spikier'] as Afterfeel[]).map((feel) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={feel}
                onPress={() => setTempAfterfeel(feel)}
                style={[
                  styles.afterfeelButton,
                  { backgroundColor: tempAfterfeel === feel ? colors.accent : colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent },
                ]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.afterfeelText, { color: colors.text }]}>{feel}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>

<Text style={[styles.tagsPrompt, { color: colors.dim }]}>What helped? (pick up to 2, or skip)</Text>

<View style={styles.tagsContainer}>
            {(['water', 'light', 'movement', 'sound', 'novelty', 'social'] as ResonanceTag[]).map((tag) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={tag}
                onPress={() => {
                  if (tempTags.includes(tag)) setTempTags(tempTags.filter((t) => t !== tag));
                  else if (tempTags.length < 2) setTempTags([...tempTags, tag]);
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.tagChip,
                  { backgroundColor: tempTags.includes(tag) ? colors.accent : colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent },
                ]}
              >

---

<Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: colors.text }]}>{tag}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>

<TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => tempAfterfeel && handleAfterfeelSelect(tempAfterfeel, tempTags)}
            style={[styles.doneButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent, opacity: tempAfterfeel ? 1 : 0.5 }]}
            disabled={!tempAfterfeel}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.doneButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>done</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<TouchableOpacity onPress={() => handleAfterfeelSelect('same', [])}>
            <Text style={[styles.skipText, { color: colors.dim }]}>skip</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: SUBSTANCES (LIST)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (currentScreen === 'substances') {
    const days = Object.keys(logsByDay).sort((a, b) => (a < b ? 1 : -1));
    const todays = logsByDay[todayKey()] || [];
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('containers')} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<Text style={[styles.patternsTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>Substances</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.patternsSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>neutral, harm-reduction view</Text>

{/* Quick add */}
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            {['caffeine', 'nicotine', 'alcohol', 'cannabis'].map((tag) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={tag}
                onPress={() => {
                  setNewSub({ ...newSub, name: tag });
                  setCurrentScreen('add-substance');
                }}
                style={[styles.tagChip, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: colors.text }]}>{tag}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => {
                setNewSub({ ...newSub, name: '' });
                setCurrentScreen('add-substance');
              }}
              style={[styles.tagChip, { backgroundColor: colors.accent, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: colors.text }]}>+ log</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

{/* Today */}
          <View style={styles.section}>
            <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>TODAY</Text>
            {todays.length === 0 ? (
              <View style={[styles.emptyState, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                <Text style={[styles.emptyText, { color: colors.dim }]}>No logs yet today.</Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              todays.map((l) => (
                <View key={l.id} style={[styles.itemCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.dim }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.itemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>
                    {l.name}
                    {l.amount ? ` — ${l.amount}${l.unit ? ' ' + l.unit : ''}` : ''}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.completionNote, { color: colors.dim }]}>
                    {new Date(l.date_iso).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}
                    {l.route ? ` • ${l.route}` : ''}
                    {l.intention ? ` • ${l.intention}` : ''}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ))
            )}
          </View>

{/* History */}
          {days.map((day) => (
            <View key={day} style={styles.section}>
              <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>{day}</Text>
              {logsByDay[day].map((l) => (
                <View key={l.id} style={[styles.itemCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.dim }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.itemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>
                    {l.name}

[1761143872.685106] Assistant: Yep—this “buttons won’t click” thing is almost always one of these in RN:

1) a full-screen overlay sitting on top (modal, toast, etc.),  
2) the keyboard stealing the first tap inside a `ScrollView`,  
3) a modal that stayed “invisibly” open after a reload,  
4) a parent view with `pointerEvents` blocking touches.

Your code already sets `pointerEvents="none"` on the phrase overlay (good), so the most likely culprit is **the keyboard + ScrollView** or **a stuck modal**. Here’s exactly what to change:

---

## 1) Make every ScrollView deliver taps even when the keyboard is up

---

Add `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"` to **all** your scroll views.

### Containers
```tsx
<ScrollView
  contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
  keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
>
```

### Item detail
(You already had “handled”; switch to “always” so taps never get swallowed.)
```tsx
<Animated.ScrollView
  style={{ opacity: fadeAnim }}
  contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
  keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
/>
```

### Outcome
```tsx
<ScrollView
  contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
  keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
>
```

### Substances (list)
```tsx
<ScrollView
  contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
  keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
>
```

### Add-substance (form)
(This one matters the most because there are inputs.)
```tsx
<ScrollView
  contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
  keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
>
```

This prevents the keyboard from “eating” your first tap and makes buttons respond even while the keyboard is open.

---

## 2) Force-close any stuck modals on mount (Android/Hot Reload quirk)
Sometimes after a reload or coming back from sleep, a `Modal` can remain mounted but invisible and block touches. Add this once:

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  // safety reset on first mount
  setShowShiftModal(false);
  setAddModalVisible(false);
}, []);
```

Also add `onRequestClose` so Android can dismiss with back button (and to keep state in sync):

```tsx
<Modal
  visible={addModalVisible}
  transparent
  animationType="slide"
  onRequestClose={() => setAddModalVisible(false)}
>
  …
</Modal>

<Modal
  visible={showShiftModal}
  transparent
  animationType="fade"
  onRequestClose={() => setShowShiftModal(false)}
>
  …
</Modal>
```

---

## 3) Keep the micro-affirmation overlay non-blocking

---

You already do `pointerEvents="none"` on it—perfect. If you ever move that overlay to other screens, keep `pointerEvents="none"` on the **outermost** overlay view.

```tsx
{completionPhrase ? (
  <Animated.View pointerEvents="none" style={[styles.phraseOverlay, { opacity: phraseOpacity }]}>
    …
  </Animated.View>
) : null}
```

---

## 4) Quick sanity check (1 minute)
- Make sure you’re not rendering any **other** full-screen view without `pointerEvents="none"`.
- Confirm no `disabled` prop snuck onto a `TouchableOpacity`.
- If only the **form screen** felt broken: it was the keyboard / scroll thing (fix #1).
- If **everywhere** felt blocked right after wake/hot-reload: it was the stuck modal (fix #2).

Do those two edits (#1 and #2) and your taps should behave again. If anything still feels sticky after that, tell me **which screen** you’re on when it happens and I’ll laser-target the spot.

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UTILITY: GET CURRENT CONTAINER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const getCurrentContainer = (): ContainerId => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 0 && hour < 6) return 'late';
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) return 'morning';
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return 'afternoon';
  return 'evening';
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN COMPONENT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export default function PDATaskAppV2() {
  // Theme
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('forest');
  const colors = THEMES[theme];

// Navigation
  const [currentScreen, setCurrentScreen] = useState<
  'containers' | 'item-detail' | 'outcome' | 'add-item' | 'patterns' | 'allies' | 'log-ally'
>('containers');

// Time containers
  const [containers] = useState<TimeContainer[]>([
    { id: 'late', label: 'Late Night / Early Morning', window: [0, 6], pressure_mode: 'normal' },
    { id: 'morning', label: 'Morning', window: [6, 12], pressure_mode: 'normal' },
    { id: 'afternoon', label: 'Afternoon', window: [12, 18], pressure_mode: 'normal' },
    { id: 'evening', label: 'Evening', window: [18, 24], pressure_mode: 'normal' }
  ]);

// Items (grounding + custom + appointments)
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ContainerItem[]>(() => {
    // Initialize with default grounding tasks
    const allItems: ContainerItem[] = [];
    let idCounter = 0;

Object.entries(DEFAULT_GROUNDING).forEach(([containerId, tasks]) => {
      tasks.forEach(task => {
        allItems.push({
          ...task,
          id: `item-${idCounter++}`,
          container: containerId as ContainerId
        });
      });
    });

return allItems;
  });

// Completions history
  const [completions, setCompletions] = useState<Completion[]>([]);

// Completion phrases (rotates, never repeats consecutively)
  const [lastPhraseIndex, setLastPhraseIndex] = useState(-1);
  const completionPhrases = [
    'good contact.',
    'small shift made.',
    'system heard you.',
    'thread tugged.',
    'momentum felt.',
    'anchor touched.'
  ];

const getCompletionPhrase = (): string => {
    let newIndex;
    do {
      newIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * completionPhrases.length);
    } while (newIndex === lastPhraseIndex && completionPhrases.length > 1);
    setLastPhraseIndex(newIndex);
    return completionPhrases[newIndex];
  };

// Current state
  const [currentContainer, setCurrentContainer] = useState<ContainerId>(getCurrentContainer());
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<ContainerItem | null>(null);
  const [showFirstPixel, setShowFirstPixel] = useState(true);
  const [selectedOutcome, setSelectedOutcome] = useState<Outcome | null>(null);
  const [showShiftModal, setShowShiftModal] = useState(false);
  const [shiftYesCount, setShiftYesCount] = useState(0);
  const [completionPhrase, setCompletionPhrase] = useState('');

// Outcome screen state (must be at top level, not in conditional render)
  const [tempAfterfeel, setTempAfterfeel] = useState<Afterfeel | null>(null);
  const [tempTags, setTempTags] = useState<ResonanceTag[]>([]);

// Ally (substance) logs
  const [allyLogs, setAllyLogs] = useState<SubstanceLog[]>([]);
  const [newLog, setNewLog] = useState<Partial<SubstanceLog>>({
    ally: 'stimulant',
    intention: 'focus',
    route: 'oral'
  });

// Add item modal
  const [addModalVisible, setAddModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [newItemTitle, setNewItemTitle] = useState('');
  const [newItemType, setNewItemType] = useState<'custom' | 'appointment'>('custom');
  const [newItemTime, setNewItemTime] = useState('');

// Animation
  const [fadeAnim] = useState(new Animated.Value(1));
  const [pulseAnim] = useState(new Animated.Value(1));

// Load ally logs from storage
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem('allyLogs');
        if (saved) setAllyLogs(JSON.parse(saved));
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, []);

// Save ally logs when they change
  useEffect(() => {
    AsyncStorage.setItem('allyLogs', JSON.stringify(allyLogs));
  }, [allyLogs]);

// Group logs by day for history view
  const logsByDay = useMemo(() => {
    return allyLogs.reduce<Record<string, SubstanceLog[]>>((acc, log) => {
      (acc[log.day_key] ||= []).push(log);
      return acc;
    }, {});
  }, [allyLogs]);

// Update current container every minute
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentContainer(getCurrentContainer());
    }, 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ANIMATION HELPERS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const triggerExhaleAnimation = () => {
    // Randomize amplitude ±5% for organic feel
    const amplitude = 0.98 + (Math.random() * 0.02 - 0.01);

pulseAnim.setValue(1);
    Animated.sequence([
      Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
        toValue: amplitude,
        duration: 200,
        useNativeDriver: true
      }),
      Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 200,
        useNativeDriver: true
      })
    ]).start();
  };

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HELPERS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const getContainerItems = (containerId: ContainerId): ContainerItem[] => {
    return items.filter(item => item.container === containerId);
  };

const getTodayCompletions = (): Completion[] => {

---

const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return completions.filter(c => c.date === today);
  };

const getItemCompletion = (itemId: string): Completion | undefined => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return completions.find(c => c.item_id === itemId && c.date === today);
  };

const handleItemTap = (item: ContainerItem) => {
    setActiveItem(item);
    setShowFirstPixel(false);
    setCurrentScreen('item-detail');
    fadeAnim.setValue(0);
    Animated.timing(fadeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 300, useNativeDriver: true }).start();
  };

const handleDeleteItem = (itemId: string) => {
    const item = items.find(i => i.id === itemId);
    if (item && item.type !== 'grounding') {
      Alert.alert(
        'Delete ritual?',
        `Remove "${item.title}" from your rituals?`,
        [
          { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
          { 
            text: 'Delete', 
            style: 'destructive',
            onPress: () => {
              setItems(items.filter(i => i.id !== itemId));
              // Also remove any completions for this item
              setCompletions(completions.filter(c => c.item_id !== itemId));
            }
          }
        ]
      );
    }
  };

const handleOutcomeSelect = (outcome: Outcome) => {
    if (!activeItem) return;

// Trigger exhale animation
    triggerExhaleAnimation();

if (outcome === 'did') {
      setSelectedOutcome(outcome);
      // Show shift modal if user hasn't disabled it
      if (shiftYesCount < 3) {
        setShowShiftModal(true);
      } else {
        // Evolved to micro-affirmation
        setCompletionPhrase('small current moved');
        setTimeout(() => {
          setTempAfterfeel(null);
          setTempTags([]);
          setCurrentScreen('outcome');
          setCompletionPhrase('');
        }, 1500);
      }
    } else {
      // For non-did outcomes, save directly
      const completion: Completion = {
        item_id: activeItem.id,
        container: activeItem.container,
        date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        outcome
      };
      setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
      setCompletionPhrase(getCompletionPhrase());

// Show phrase briefly then return
      setTimeout(() => {
        setActiveItem(null);
        setCurrentScreen('containers');
        setCompletionPhrase('');
      }, 1200);
    }
  };

const handleAfterfeelSelect = (afterfeel: Afterfeel, tags: ResonanceTag[]) => {

  const outcomeToSave: Outcome = selectedOutcome ?? 'did';

const completion: Completion = {
    item_id: activeItem.id,
    container: activeItem.container,
    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],

  };

setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
  setCompletionPhrase(getCompletionPhrase());

setTimeout(() => {
    setActiveItem(null);
    setSelectedOutcome(null);
    setCurrentScreen('containers');
    setCompletionPhrase('');
  }, 1200);
};
  const handleShiftResponse = (felt: boolean) => {

    setTempAfterfeel(null);
    setTempTags([]);
    setCurrentScreen('outcome');
  };

setItems([...items, newItem]);

const getPatternInsights = () => {
    const today = new Date();
    const weekAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const weekCompletions = completions.filter(c => new Date(c.date) >= weekAgo);

// Calculate completion rates per item
    const itemStats: { [key: string]: { did: number; total: number; tags: ResonanceTag[] } } = {};

items.forEach(item => {
      const itemCompletions = weekCompletions.filter(c => c.item_id === item.id);
      const didCount = itemCompletions.filter(c => c.outcome === 'did').length;
      const allTags = itemCompletions.flatMap(c => c.resonance_tags || []);

itemStats[item.id] = {
        did: didCount,
        total: itemCompletions.length,
        tags: allTags
      };
    });

// Find resonating tasks (high completion)

---

const resonating = items
      .filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.did >= 4)
      .map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));

// Find not-sticking tasks (low completion)
    const notSticking = items
      .filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.total >= 3 && itemStats[item.id]?.did <= 1)
      .map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));

return { resonating, notSticking, weekCompletions };
  };

                    setTempTags([...tempTags, tag]);

                }}

              {notSticking.map(({ item, count }) => (

{resonating.length === 0 && notSticking.length === 0 && (

[1761149215.73008] Assistant: Love where you’re going with the “living pharmacopoeia.” I see a few concrete issues + missing pieces in what you pasted:

- Your **header buttons are nested** (a `<TouchableOpacity>` inside another), which can swallow taps.  
- The **Allies screens** (`'allies'` and `'log-ally'`) aren’t implemented yet.  
- In `styles`, your **`phraseText` block never closes**, so all the ally styles got nested inside it — that breaks styles and sometimes touch handling.  
- Several `ScrollView`s don’t have `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"`.

Below are **copy-paste patches**. I kept them minimal so you can drop them in.

---

## 1) Fix the header buttons (no nesting)

**Replace** the header block in the `containers` screen with this:

```tsx
{/* Header */}
<View style={styles.header}>
  <Text style={[styles.containerTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>
    {containerData?.label}
  </Text>

<View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 16 }}>
    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('allies')}>
      <Text style={[styles.headerLink, { color: colors.accent }]}>allies</Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('patterns')}>
      <Text style={[styles.headerLink, { color: colors.accent }]}>patterns</Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  </View>
</View>
```

Also add `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"` on the `ScrollView` here:

```tsx
<ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always">
```

Do the same for every other `ScrollView`/`Animated.ScrollView` in the file.

---

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TYPE DEFINITIONS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

type ContainerId = 'late' | 'morning' | 'afternoon' | 'evening';
type ItemType = 'grounding' | 'custom' | 'appointment';
type Outcome = 'did' | 'skipped' | 'forgot' | 'couldnt' | 'not_relevant';
type Afterfeel = 'lighter' | 'same' | 'spikier';
type ResonanceTag = 'water' | 'light' | 'movement' | 'sound' | 'novelty' | 'social';
type MissReason = 'forgot' | 'overwhelm' | 'transport' | 'conflict' | 'logistics' | 'cost' | 'not_ready';
type PressureMode = 'normal' | 'softened';

// ── Substance Ally System (Living Pharmacopoeia)
type SubstanceAlly = 
  | 'benzodiazepine'
  | 'stimulant'
  | 'cannabis'
  | 'opioid'
  | 'entheogen'
  | 'alcohol'
  | 'nootropic';

type SubstanceRoute = 'oral' | 'smoked' | 'vaped' | 'sublingual' | 'nasal' | 'topical' | 'other';
type SubstanceIntention = 'relief' | 'focus' | 'connection' | 'exploration' | 'rest' | 'celebration' | 'medicine';
type SubstanceRelation = 'lighter' | 'same' | 'spikier' | 'teachings' | 'warnings';

interface AllyArchetype {
  name: string;
  face: string; // The ally's name/title
  function: string; // What it offers
  shadow: string; // What it can become
  invocation: string; // Prayer/intention to hold
}

interface SubstanceLog {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string; // Full ISO datetime
  day_key: string; // YYYY-MM-DD for grouping
  ally: SubstanceAlly;
  specific_name?: string; // e.g., "lorazepam", "coffee", "psilocybin"
  amount?: string;
  route?: SubstanceRoute;
  intention?: SubstanceIntention;

// Pre-contact
  state_before?: string; // Free text: nervous system state
  craving_intensity?: number; // 0-10

// Post-contact
  felt_effect?: SubstanceRelation;
  state_after?: string; // What shifted
  gratitude?: string; // What you learned/received
  caution?: string; // Shadow aspects noticed

// Context
  with_others?: boolean;
  setting?: string; // Where: home, social, nature, etc.
}

interface ContainerItem {
  id: string;
  type: ItemType;
  title: string;
  body_cue?: string;
  micro_version?: string;
  container: ContainerId;

// If appointment
  time?: string;
  date?: string;
  warmup_enabled?: boolean;
  warmup_task?: string;
  buffer_minutes?: number;
}

interface Completion {
  item_id: string;
  container: ContainerId;
  date: string;
  outcome: Outcome;
  afterfeel?: Afterfeel;
  resonance_tags?: ResonanceTag[];
  miss_reason?: MissReason;
}

interface TimeContainer {
  id: ContainerId;
  label: string;
  window: [number, number];
  pressure_mode: PressureMode;
}

interface ThemeColors {
  bg: string;
  card: string;
  accent: string;
  text: string;
  dim: string;
}

const getCurrentContainer = (): ContainerId => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 0 && hour < 6) return 'late';
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) return 'morning';
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return 'afternoon';
  return 'evening';
};

          ...task,

        });
      });
    });

return allItems;

// Completions history
  const [completions, setCompletions] = useState<Completion[]>([]);

// Completion phrases (rotates, never repeats consecutively)
  const [lastPhraseIndex, setLastPhraseIndex] = useState(-1);
  const completionPhrases = [
    'good contact.',
    'small shift made.',
    'system heard you.',
    'thread tugged.',
    'momentum felt.',
    'anchor touched.'
  ];

const getCompletionPhrase = (): string => {
    let newIndex;
    do {
      newIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * completionPhrases.length);
    } while (newIndex === lastPhraseIndex && completionPhrases.length > 1);
    setLastPhraseIndex(newIndex);
    return completionPhrases[newIndex];
  };

// Current state
  const [currentContainer, setCurrentContainer] = useState<ContainerId>(getCurrentContainer());
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<ContainerItem | null>(null);
  const [showFirstPixel, setShowFirstPixel] = useState(true);
  const [selectedOutcome, setSelectedOutcome] = useState<Outcome | null>(null);
  const [showShiftModal, setShowShiftModal] = useState(false);
  const [shiftYesCount, setShiftYesCount] = useState(0);
  const [completionPhrase, setCompletionPhrase] = useState('');

// Outcome screen state (must be at top level, not in conditional render)
  const [tempAfterfeel, setTempAfterfeel] = useState<Afterfeel | null>(null);
  const [tempTags, setTempTags] = useState<ResonanceTag[]>([]);

// Ally (substance) logs

    ally: 'stimulant',

// Animation
  const [fadeAnim] = useState(new Animated.Value(1));
  const [pulseAnim] = useState(new Animated.Value(1));

// Load ally logs from storage
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem('allyLogs');
        if (saved) setAllyLogs(JSON.parse(saved));
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, []);

// Save ally logs when they change
  useEffect(() => {
    AsyncStorage.setItem('allyLogs', JSON.stringify(allyLogs));
  }, [allyLogs]);

// Group logs by day for history view
  const logsByDay = useMemo(() => {

      (acc[log.day_key] ||= []).push(log);

// Update current container every minute
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentContainer(getCurrentContainer());
    }, 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

const triggerExhaleAnimation = () => {
    // Randomize amplitude ±5% for organic feel
    const amplitude = 0.98 + (Math.random() * 0.02 - 0.01);

pulseAnim.setValue(1);
    Animated.sequence([
      Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
        toValue: amplitude,
        duration: 200,
        useNativeDriver: true
      }),
      Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 200,
        useNativeDriver: true
      })
    ]).start();
  };

const getContainerItems = (containerId: ContainerId): ContainerItem[] => {
    return items.filter(item => item.container === containerId);
  };

const getTodayCompletions = (): Completion[] => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return completions.filter(c => c.date === today);
  };

const getItemCompletion = (itemId: string): Completion | undefined => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return completions.find(c => c.item_id === itemId && c.date === today);
  };

const handleItemTap = (item: ContainerItem) => {
    setActiveItem(item);
    setShowFirstPixel(false);
    setCurrentScreen('item-detail');
    fadeAnim.setValue(0);
    Animated.timing(fadeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 300, useNativeDriver: true }).start();
  };

const handleDeleteItem = (itemId: string) => {
    const item = items.find(i => i.id === itemId);
    if (item && item.type !== 'grounding') {
      Alert.alert(
        'Delete ritual?',
        `Remove "${item.title}" from your rituals?`,
        [
          { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
          { 
            text: 'Delete', 
            style: 'destructive',
            onPress: () => {
              setItems(items.filter(i => i.id !== itemId));
              // Also remove any completions for this item
              setCompletions(completions.filter(c => c.item_id !== itemId));
            }
          }
        ]
      );
    }
  };

const handleOutcomeSelect = (outcome: Outcome) => {
    if (!activeItem) return;

// Trigger exhale animation
    triggerExhaleAnimation();

if (outcome === 'did') {
      setSelectedOutcome(outcome);

        setShowShiftModal(true);

          setTempTags([]);
          setCurrentScreen('outcome');
          setCompletionPhrase('');
        }, 1500);
      }

// Show phrase briefly then return

  };

const completion: Completion = {

    container: activeItem.container,
    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],

  };

setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
  setCompletionPhrase(getCompletionPhrase());

setTimeout(() => {
    setActiveItem(null);
    setSelectedOutcome(null);
    setCurrentScreen('containers');
    setCompletionPhrase('');
  }, 1200);
};
  const handleShiftResponse = (felt: boolean) => {

const getPatternInsights = () => {
    const today = new Date();
    const weekAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const weekCompletions = completions.filter(c => new Date(c.date) >= weekAgo);

// Calculate completion rates per item
    const itemStats: { [key: string]: { did: number; total: number; tags: ResonanceTag[] } } = {};

items.forEach(item => {
      const itemCompletions = weekCompletions.filter(c => c.item_id === item.id);
      const didCount = itemCompletions.filter(c => c.outcome === 'did').length;
      const allTags = itemCompletions.flatMap(c => c.resonance_tags || []);

itemStats[item.id] = {
        did: didCount,
        total: itemCompletions.length,
        tags: allTags
      };
    });

// Find resonating tasks (high completion)
    const resonating = items
      .filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.did >= 4)
      .map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));

// Find not-sticking tasks (low completion)
    const notSticking = items
      .filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.total >= 3 && itemStats[item.id]?.did <= 1)
      .map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));

return { resonating, notSticking, weekCompletions };
  };
